category.description: Does this email announce something happening at a set date or time, and what kind of thing?

change.description: Is this a new announcement, a change to an earlier one (new date, time or venue), a cancellation, or a reminder?

audience.description: Who is it for: only me or a few named people, my course or section, or everyone on campus?

multiple.description: Does the email list several separate events or dates, like a schedule?

title.description: A short title for the event as a timetable entry, like 'CS F211 Midsem' or 'Quiz 2 deadline'. No greeting, sender or date. Null if there is no event.

venue.description: Where it happens, as written: room, hall or building, like 'F105' or 'Main Auditorium'. 'Online' if only online. If changed, the new place. Null if not given.

date.description: The day it happens or is due, if the email writes a calendar date (a day and month). Null for only today, tomorrow or a weekday. If changed, the new date.

start.description: Start time on a 24-hour clock, like 09:30:00 or 17:00:00. For a deadline, the due time. If changed, the new time. A class hour N (like '9th hour') starts at N+7 o'clock: 1st hour 08:00, 9th hour 16:00. Null if no time is given.

end.description: End time on a 24-hour clock, like 17:00:00. A class hour ends 50 minutes after it starts. Null if no end time is given.
